forms.plain_english: Statement of changes in beneficial ownership. Filed by directors, officers and 10%+ holders within 2 business days of any change (purchase, sale, grant, vesting settlement, tax withholding, gift, option exercise). Each filing carries an ownershipDocument XML with one row per transaction, a transaction code, price, post-transaction holdings, direct/indirect flag and footnotes.
forms.who_files_when: Section 16 insiders; due by end of 2nd business day after the transaction (Exchange Act s16(a); 10b5-1 flag box added April 2023). Filed under BOTH the reporting person's CIK and the issuer's CIK, so the issuer Atom feed with owner=include lists all insiders' filings. 4/A corrects a prior Form 4. Apple/Alphabet/Netflix/MSFT/AMZN each file several per month; clusters on vest dates (Apple Oct 1 and Apr 1, Alphabet 25th monthly, MSFT mid-month/quarter).

machine_readable.format: XML (ownershipDocument, schema X0609) - one XML per filing, plus .txt SGML; primary xml file name varies (form4.xml, ownership.xml, wk-form4_NNN.xml) by filing agent
structured_fields: nonDerivativeTransaction: securityTitle, transactionDate, transactionCode, shares, pricePerShare, acquiredDisposed, sharesOwnedFollowingTransaction, directOrIndirectOwnership, natureOfOwnership
derivativeTransaction: conversionOrExercisePrice, exercise/expiration dates, underlying shares

products.name: Cluster-buying signal
